_note: robofast PDU server (Alpaca Switch) for the MINERVA T2 APC rack PDU (AP7900), through an SSH tunnel: docs/recovery.md, docs/remote.md.
SNMP is UDP and ssh -L carries TCP only, so the far end of the tunnel is scripts/snmp_relay.py on the site gateway, relaying to the PDU and nothing else; hence pdu.relay true.
Outlet names are the PDU's own (SNMP sPDUOutletCtlName); legacy apc_2.ini has the same order.
Only inst (the Apogee camera) and panel (the mount electronics and the Apogee filter wheel) may be switched or power-cycled. Cycling panel drops the mount controller: re-home in PWI4 afterwards.
The telcom PC, the heater, the Aqawan router (the enclosure's network) and CAMAL's outlets can never be switched from here.
credentials: {"read": ..., "write": ...} SNMP communities, chmod 600, outside every repository.
allow_hardware is true, but nothing talks to the real PDU without --hardware on the command line as well (robofast/hwgate.py).
